payload.summary: The denitrification implementation is well-structured and scientifically sound. The diff (from plan_and_implement to apply_fixes) adds: (1) invariant clamping for denitrifier_activity_index [0,1] and non-negative validation for cumulative_n2_export_mg_n and all denitrification process parameters; (2) updated doc comment for DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N; (3) significantly strengthened tests including a new `long_horizon_denitrification_state` helper and tighter assertions. The core denitrification logic correctly implements dual-Monod kinetics, stoichiometric DOC consumption (5/4 × 12/14.007 ≈ 1.071 mg C/mg N), DIC production, alkalinity production (1/14.007 meq/mg N), and N₂ gas export tracked as explicit permanent export in the budget. Mass balance is properly maintained. The daily maturation ramp uses an exponential approach that requires a suboxic zone to exist. All 12 tests pass. No real bugs, safety problems, or correctness gaps found.
